assertions.name: Rust kernel present (the words captured are the ones it receives)
every partition of a given k receives identical chains, equal to _step_chain_generic(ordering[i], ordering[:i], k-1)
NO (atom, k) word is level-local: segments_of returns ONE segment covering every generator, for every atom and every k
every adjacent generator pair (g, g+1) interleaves in every word — far commutation cannot separate them
no cyclic rotation of any word has > 1 segment
p–n crossings carry the colour-weighted offset _PN_D_MP, not −h/2
single-segment path-sum reproduces the kernel's final trace on every λ ⊢ k, k ≤ 6, all four light atoms (worst rel 8.62e-50)
T_w expansion validated at k=3: Σ_w x_w χ^λ(T_w) = seminormal χ^λ(x) for all λ ⊢ 3 (Rust characters of T_w)
reduction: every ordered ≥2-interval product set W_{I_1}⋯W_{I_m} lies in some 2-block W_J·W_K or W_K·W_J (k = 3..6, exhaustive)
T_w expansion reproduces the trivial and sign representations (Π(q+d), Π(−q⁻¹+d)) at every k expanded

support of the word's Hecke element lies in NO 2-block parabolic product W_J·W_K / W_K·W_J, for every atom, every k ≤ 7, and every cyclic rotation for k ≤ 5 — no Hecke-relation rewriting of the word or of any rotation is level-local with ≥ 2 segments

description: qou-hxz4: the braid words hecke_core_legacy.unified_iterative_correction hands its Rust kernel (captured by instrumenting _lp_kernel_steps) are NOT level-local for any atom or any partition size k: the generator index cycles g mod (k-1) through every letter of every step, so the first letter that breaks locality is the third (σ_1 σ_2 σ_1 …), every adjacent generator pair interleaves, and segments_of returns a single segment covering all k-1 generators. No trace-preserving reordering restores it: every cyclic rotation is single-segment, and the T_w-support of the word's Hecke element (and of every rotation's) lies in NO 2-block parabolic product W_J.W_K / W_K.W_J, which excludes every Hecke-relation rewriting into >= 2 disjoint-interval factors (the T_{w0} coefficient alone is not decisive: it vanishes for 2H at k = 6, 7 because the 23-letter word cannot reach w0). The #7160 path-sum therefore degenerates to the O(L·dim^2) direct seminormal trace on this producer — measured slower than the Rust kernel — and is not a route past qou-sv7h's wall. Word transcription verified against the kernel at <= 1e-45 relative.
caveats: Timings are wall-clock strings (seconds), provenance only. scope-(b) for cyclic rotation at every k and for Hecke-relation rewriting at k <= k_tw; scope-(a) for rewriting at k > k_tw. Conjugation by an arbitrary invertible element of H_k(q) is trace-preserving and is NOT tested: choosing such a conjugator to reach a level-local word would be selection, not derivation.
